content: Telegram bot platform architecture for daily content delivery: Standard pattern is 4-process modular monolith: 1) Bot process (aiogram) — handles user interactions, commands, callbacks. 2) API process (FastAPI) — webhooks (payment), admin panel backend. 3) Worker process (ARQ) — executes queued tasks (message sending, payment processing). 4) Scheduler process (APScheduler) — triggers daily jobs at specific times, enqueues to ARQ. All share PostgreSQL + Redis. Key insight: APScheduler triggers, ARQ executes — clean separation. For 08:00 daily scroll delivery: APScheduler cron fires at 07:55 → enqueues 'send_daily_scroll' job to ARQ → worker queries eligible users → enqueues individual 'send_scroll_to_user' jobs → worker sends messages with rate limiting → updates delivery status. This prevents the 'thundering herd' problem where all 500 messages try to send at exactly 08:00.
